mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% consistently signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 7.5% indicates labor market tightening, accelerating consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 7.5%, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) confirms robust consumer demand, accelerating corporate revenue growth and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS rise, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth above 100 (2017=100) during early-cycle expansion signals manufacturing momentum, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In early-cycle expansion (INDPRO > 100), 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Annual CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals imminent monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL rises above 2.5% annually, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of observations.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly job growth (PAYEMS rising) consistently indicates improving economic conditions, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS rises, 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) growth signal robust economic expansion, accelerating corporate revenue and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When both GDPC1 and HOUST rise, 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 1.5% during late-cycle monetary tightening increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 1.5%), 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of observations.
